_meta.description: Maximum years of experience the candidate can credibly claim per CV variant. Used by scoring and tailoring to avoid over-claiming. Every cap must be anchored in actual master_cv.json evidence.
_meta.how_to_use: This is an example file with placeholder entries for the 'Alex Example' persona. The /onboard skill generates the real file at cv/variants/seniority_caps.json (gitignored, since it encodes personal career history). Add one entry per CV variant in cv/variants/.
_meta.tolerance_note: When a JD requires N years and the variant cap is C, application is allowed if N <= C + tolerance_years. Strict skip when N > C + tolerance_years.

general.rationale: Full ExampleCorp tenure plus internship; broadly applicable analyst evidence, 3 years direct
